region: Muthathi / Sangama reach, Cauvery Wildlife Sanctuary, Kanakapura taluk, Karnataka
note: No staff gauge or stage/water-level sensor exists at Muthathi itself, and no public agency publishes river-stage data for this specific reach. Unlike discharge, stage cannot be reasonably derived from upstream reservoir levels without local cross-section/channel data, which is not publicly available. Below are the real, sourced reservoir water levels that govern this reach, not a Muthathi-specific reading.

source: Oneindia, 'Dam Water Level Today in India (1st September 2026)'

trend: falling - outflow to Tamil Nadu (9,253 cusecs) exceeding inflow (3,028 cusecs)
source: Star of Mysore, 'KRS level falls as outflow to TN exceeds inflow', published 2026-09-03

qualitative_trend: river level in this reach is likely elevated relative to baseline because both KRS and Kabini are releasing large volumes to Tamil Nadu (combined ~12,253 cusecs on 2026-09-03), arriving with an estimated 1-2 day lag
uncertainty: cannot quantify actual stage (metres/feet of water level in the river channel) without a local staff gauge or surveyed cross-section for this reach - only a qualitative direction (rising/falling/high/low relative to recent releases) can be inferred

fields_explained.reservoir_level_ft: height of water surface in the reservoir, in feet above a fixed datum - NOT the same as river stage downstream
fields_explained.numeric_stage_estimate: river water level in the channel itself - left null here because it cannot be derived from the data available
fields_explained.confidence: 'reported' = stated directly by an official/press source; 'estimated_qualitative_only' = direction inferred, no numeric value possible from available data
